items.t: ZIM Q3 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates on Strong Freight Rates
items.sum: ZIM's Q3 2026 earnings beat on higher freight rates and volumes, driving strong margin growth, robust cash flow and another upward revision to its annual outlook.

items.t: Barclays Maintains Equal-Weight on ZIM Integrated Shipping, Raises Price Target to $32.5
items.sum: Barclays analyst Marco Limite maintains ZIM Integrated Shipping (NYSE:ZIM) with a Equal-Weight and raises the price target from $30 to $32.5.

items.t: ZIM: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.sum: Long-term charters with purchase options give ZIM a way to keep vessel costs stable, a cost lever many shipping rivals lack.

items.t: ZIM Just Posted Huge Profits, But Its $35 Buyout Is Still in Limbo
items.sum: ZIM posted record Q3 results and raised guidance, but its stock remains tied to the pending Hapag-Lloyd merger, which faces delays amid Israeli regulatory and governance hurdles.
